policy: These criteria are saved before the initial run. Failed runs and failed checks are retained. Changes require a new named revision and may not overwrite this initial contract.
norm_definition: sum_i V_i |rho_i-rho_exact_cellavg_i| / sum_i V_i rho_exact_cellavg_i; L2 and Linf recorded separately.
masks: center=r_right<=.25*r_shock; shock=cells intersecting r_shock±3*dx; plateau=cell wholly within [.25,.70]*r_shock. All full-domain errors are always retained.
notes: No requirement of vanishing central maximum error: first-order shock-capturing wall/origin heating is an intended diagnostic, not hidden by excluding the center.
Shock location and plateau diagnostics do not replace volume-weighted full-domain error.
A cell containing the discontinuity has p(average(U)) different from average(p); both reference quantities are retained.
Compression across the shock is 4; density amplification relative to initial rho0 is 4^d.
Negative pressure within stated floating-point roundoff is logged; only a wave-speed sqrt argument may use zero at roundoff. No conservative state or pressure is repaired.
